rules.title: S3 bucket does not have strong public access block settings
rules.recommendation: Add aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block with all block/restrict settings enabled.

rules.title: Security group allows inbound access from the internet
rules.recommendation: Restrict inbound CIDR ranges to a trusted network or remove the rule.

rules.title: Security group exposes a sensitive port to the internet
rules.recommendation: Do not expose SSH, RDP, databases, or admin ports to 0.0.0.0/0.

rules.title: IAM policy grants wildcard admin permissions
rules.recommendation: Replace Action '*' and Resource '*' with least-privilege permissions.

rules.title: RDS storage encryption is disabled
rules.recommendation: Set storage_encrypted = true and use a managed KMS key where appropriate.

rules.title: EBS or root volume encryption is disabled
rules.recommendation: Enable encryption for all block storage.

rules.title: Resource is missing required governance tags
rules.recommendation: Add Project, Owner, Environment, and CostCenter tags.

rules.title: Terraform plan contains a delete action
rules.recommendation: Require human approval before destructive infrastructure changes.
